comparison.objective: Count six bolts and place exactly half in a cup; candidate adjusts and validates a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Counting, repeated small-part grasping, and cup placement versus recessed key insertion, collar rotation, counterholding, and response-based tuning.
comparison.success_condition: Exactly three bolts must be inside the cup below the wall tops; candidate requires an ordered adjustment sequence and two safe dynamic cycles. No bolt damage or final-stability thresholds are stated.
comparison.reason: Quantity reasoning and repeated part transfer test a different ability.
